items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: It’s just like Wynton Marsalis with the —

ctx.x: All right. I’ll be checking it out. And do you hear artists out there these days that you think are doing anything new?

That’s difficult for me to say because first of all, [sings] don’t get around much anymore. But if I do I’m on the outskirts of town. But just listening to the records or CD’s, or things, unfortunately no. Because I don’t know why Blue Note wants to recreate Art Blakey’s sound. You can’t. There’s no players that can — they can duplicate it but the feeling’s not there. So why not let these new, young artists do their own thing? You know what I mean? Give them their own voice. And therefore that question is…
